{{Otheruses|Capacitor}}
A '''capacitor bank''' was an energy storage unit. Rows of capacitor banks were used in the inner mechanisms of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. The energy stored in the capacitor banks was converted into charged [[Laser/Legends|laser]] beams via the weapon's [[Laser actuator/Legends|laser actuators]]. The storage capability of the capacitor banks allowed the turbolaser to fire rapidly.
